scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/persistence/migrations && cp src/persistence/migrations/*.sql dist/persistence/migrations/
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "if(!process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL){console.error(\"TEST_DATABASE_URL is required for E2E\");process.exit(1)}" && vitest run test/e2e
scripts.test:agent-workspace: node -e "if(!process.env.AGENT_WORKSPACE_ARTIFACT_URL_V1||!process.env.AGENT_WORKSPACE_ARTIFACT_URL_V2){console.error(\"AGENT_WORKSPACE_ARTIFACT_URL_V1 and _V2 are required\");process.exit(1)}" && vitest run test/integration/agent-workspace-url.integration.test.ts
